applicabilityBasis.summary: DOC targets one U.S. dollar and is usable for transfers and payments. Users mint and redeem against rBTC through the protocol; published mechanics provide dollar-equivalent Bitcoin, rather than national currency or a deposit. The terms describe autonomous smart contracts and do not evidence a fixed-monetary-value redemption obligation of an identified token issuer. Applicability is unclear under GENIUS section 2(22), with payment use present but the issuer and monetary-redemption limbs unresolved.

genius.notes: The privacy policy identifies MOC INVESTMENT CORP. (mimLABS) as website operator, but no opened source establishes that corporation as the legal DOC redemption obligor. issuerEntity and domicile are therefore omitted. Terms section 2.3 names the United States among restricted jurisdictions for software use; this is an interface restriction, not a GENIUS approval or blanket secondary-token prohibition. Protocol redemption delivers rBTC and can incur fees. No monthly independent token-reserve attestation was located in the reviewed materials.
